example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই গ্রামের সবাই জানে, তারা উচ্ছের ঝাড়।
এই শহরে তাদের পরিবারকে উচ্ছের ঝাড় বলে ডাকা হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone in the village knows they are a notorious lineage.
In this city, their family is called a thicket of wild grass.
history: Originating from agrarian Bengali folklore, symbolizing untamed, worthless growth akin to a disreputable family tree.
note: The idiom draws from rural imagery of wild, invasive grass bushes representing chaotic or infamous heritage.
